concerns.text: T035 (SHAP Consistency) depends on T023 (hyperparameter_search.csv) which is currently marked as uncompleted (`- [ ]`). T035 requires the 'best configuration' to re-train, but T023 is the task that logs/saves this configuration. This creates a blocking dependency where a parallel task (Phase 4.5) cannot start until a dependent task in Phase 4 (T023) is finished, violating the 'parallel-safe' intent of Phase 4.5.

T030 (Verify artifact existence) depends on T028 (collinearity_report.md). However, T028 is marked as uncompleted (`- [ ]`). T030 acts as a gate for the entire User Story 3 validation but cannot proceed until T028 finishes. This creates a hidden serial dependency within a phase intended for parallel execution of analysis tasks.

T029 (Perturbation study) depends on T022 (Save best model). T022 is marked as uncompleted (`- [ ]`). T029 requires the 'fixed best model' to run inference. Since T022 is the producer of this artifact and is not yet complete, T029 cannot execute. This violates the producer-before-consumer rule for the model artifact.

T022 and T023 are marked as uncompleted (`- [ ]`) while their dependencies (T020, T021) are marked complete (`[X]`). This suggests a missing execution step or a logical gap where the 'Save' and 'Log' tasks were not triggered by the completion of the training/evaluation tasks, breaking the artifact flow continuity.
